svg.title: Rendering crosses into unauthorized execution
svg.desc: Mark a scope transition from data rendering into unauthorized execution at the worker boundary. The crossing is the focal change, with commands and outputs remaining unreadable.

**Action:** Attacker-controlled metadata reaches the operating-system command boundary.
